displayName.ja: 【護幽鬼】 鬼蜘蛛　三郎

profile.ja:
ふうま八将が一角・二車家の元幹部。
東京キングダムで二車忍軍が敗れるも生き残り、楽尚之助とともに落ち延びた。
その後は廃棄都市アミダハラで『さざれ旅団』を結成、その副団長として頭角を現す。
鬼蜘蛛家は代々“獣遁の術”使いで知られ、当主となるものは「三郎」を引き継ぐ。
そして18代目三郎が彼女である。
18代目三郎の“獣遁の術”は通称“獣使い”とも呼ばれる忍法で、巨大な鬼蜘蛛の大五郎を操る。
しかし彼女は東京キングダムにおける死霊卿勢力との戦いで大五郎を失った。
そして、絶望と強い怒りの中で彼女は新しい力に目覚める。
鬼蜘蛛使いの暗黒面とも言うべきその力は、彼女を何処に導くのか。
profile.en: She is a former executive of the Fuuma Hachishin, specifically from the Ichikaku-Nishasha household. She survived the defeat of the Nishasha ninja forces in the Tokyo Kingdom and fled with Gaku Shonosuke. Later, she formed the "Sazare Traveling Party" in the abandoned city of Amidahara and became its vice-leader. The Onigumo family has long been known for their mastery of the "Kemono Tonko" technique, with each successive leader inheriting the name "Saburo". She is the 18th Saburo, and her "Kemono Tonko" technique is also known as "Kemonotsukai", which allows her to control the giant Onigumo, Daigoro. However, she lost Daigoro during the battle against the Corpse Lord's forces in the Tokyo Kingdom, and in her despair and anger, she discovered a new power. This dark power, akin to the shadow of the Onigumo user, will lead her down a certain path.

text.ja: 姿かたちが変わったからって、今さら自己紹介は必要ないでしょう？　……またこうして手を結ぶとはね。妙な縁よ
text.en: I don't think I need to introduce myself just because my appearance has changed, do I? ...And yet, here we are, joining forces again. What a strange bond.

text.ja: 随分と変わった、って？　そうね。いつまでも同じものなんてないもの。変わったのは私だけじゃない、あなたもそうでしょう？
text.en: You think I've changed, don't you? Well, I suppose you're right. Nothing stays the same forever. And it's not just me who's changed - you have too, haven't you?

text.ja: どれだけ惨めな姿だったとしても、生きてさえいればすべて取り返せる。嗤われたら、あとで嗤い返してやればいいだけの話でしょう
text.en: No matter how miserable I looked, as long as I'm alive, I can get everything back. If you laugh at me, I'll just laugh back at you later - that's all.

text.ja: 無理に話しかける必要はないわよ。気を遣っているの？　だとすればお門違いね。憐れまれると余計に腹が立つ。普通で接してちょうだい
text.en: You don't need to force yourself to talk to me. Are you trying to be considerate? If so, you're wasting your time. I don't want your pity - it just makes me angrier. Just treat me normally, please.

text.ja: 髪の色？　あぁ、変わったわね。あの黒、気に入っていたけど……装いも変わったことだし、今はこの色のほうが落ち着くかもしれないわ
text.en: My hair color? Ah, yes, it has changed. I liked the black, but...my outfit has changed too, so maybe this color suits me better now.

text.ja: 力は手に入った。強大な力が。重要なのは……この力をどう使うかよ。もう二度と同じ過ちは繰り返さないわ。今度こそ、私は――
text.en: I've gained power - great power. What's important now is...how I use it. I won't make the same mistake again. This time, I...

text.ja: この格好は慣れるまでに時間がかかりそうね。見た目は似ているけど、着心地が違う。変な目で見たらどうなるか、わかっているのかしら？
text.en: I think it'll take some time to get used to this new look. It looks similar, but the feel is different. Do you know what will happen if you look at me strangely?

text.ja: 失って初めて大切だったことに気づく、なんてバカバカしい。失う前から、大切なものは大切だってわかるのが普通でしょうに……
text.en: It's foolish to realize what's important only after you've lost it. Normally, you should know what's important before you lose it...

text.ja: くっ……せっかくの衣装をよくも！　これがあなたの思惑だったってわけね。はぁはぁ……手に負えない変態よ！！　んぐっ！　くぅ……
text.en: Ugh...you've ruined my new outfit! I suppose this was your plan all along. Hah...you're unbelievable, you pervert! Nngh...uuuh...

text.ja: わ、私に身体まで捧げろっていうの！？　ううっ……よくもそんなことを。あとで絶対に後悔させてやるんだからっ……んあああっ！？
text.en: You're asking me to dedicate my body to you?! Ugh...how dare you. I'll make you regret this later...nnngh...ahhh...

text.ja: お、オチンポをどうかお恵みください……。こんなことを言わせて、タダじゃおかないから！！　覚えてなさいっ、ううっ、あああっ
text.en: Oh, please grant me your...uh, favor...I won't let you off scot-free for making me say this! Remember that...uuuh, ahhh...
